svg.text: claudia composes — tables
Proposal for review — nothing is built (E9.32). An own table is an object of the kind table whose cells are words, with its own look and placement.
A · An own table in Flow view
Insert ▸ Table… put it after the caret’s paragraph. The caret is in the Roof beds row; tobi is in the Courtyard row.

The roof beds gave the most per bed, which we had not expected.
We come back to this in section 3.
The chip names the table: one name in the document for the
table, like a sheet or a figure (D550), and the way to its
options (D). The name is what “Harvest by site” in the #
list of the chat points at.
The header row is the columns’ names: retyping one renames
the column, as Harvest in Sales[Harvest] does in computes
(D600). Sort and the total row work on these names.
A cell is words, like a text box’s (D181): one style,
authors kept, references allowed. Numbers are words too;
the document’s language reads them when a total, a sort or
a chart needs the value.
tobi’s cell is locked for everybody else, as the words
around his caret are (D11). Rows, columns and sort are
refused while someone is in the rows they would change.
The total row is derived, never typed: a sum per column (or
mean, count, min, max), like Excel’s total row. Tab in the
last cell adds a row; the table grows with its last row
The look is three styles, not cell formatting: Table
header, Table body, Table total (D309). Rules, not boxes.
B · Insert ▸ Table… (key still to be chosen)
One small dialog; everything else is the options (D).

Floating needs the object layer’s wrap (floating-objects);

svg.text: C · Row and Column, as in computes
They appear in Edit (and in the context menu) only while the
caret is in a table: what is not meaningful is not shown.

g.text: Insert Left Shift+Alt+← · Insert Right Shift+Alt+→ · Delete Ctrl+Alt+_
The keys are computes’: one entry has one key in all three
apps (UX-35). Row and Column act on the rows and columns
Sort rewrites the order of the rows by one command with an
exact inverse; row ids never change.

svg.text: D · Table options
From the chip, the context menu, or Insert ▸ Table with the caret
on it. Each change is one undoable step.

Kind and Total are per column; Purpose is the table’s and a column’s
(D604), drawn only when View ▸ Purposes is on.

svg.text: E · On the page: Page view, print preview, PDF
The same table, laid out by the one library (D901). The table is longer than the rest of the page, so it continues.

g.text: The header row is drawn again on page 2 (an option, on by default). It is not copied: the
A row is never split between pages; a row taller than a page is the one exception. A table
is paginated by rows as a paragraph is by lines (D901).
Column widths come from the words, by integer arithmetic in the library: the same in the
editor’s Page view, the print preview and the PDF. A width typed by hand (a share of the
The PDF is tagged: header cells, the total row as footer, the table’s name and description
docx and odt carry it as a real table with a repeating header row, the name as its title and
the description as its alternative text.

svg.text: F · A linked table: the same object with a source (waits for E12.2)
Pulled from a computes range through the person’s client (D72, D535). The cells are a snapshot; the source is a remembered pointer.
Up to date
Linked · Q3 model ▸ Harvest · revision 41
Cells are read-only here: edit the source.
The look, total row, caption and placement
stay yours.
The source changed
Source changed since 41 · Review…
Review shows old against new. Nothing
changes until an owner or editor accepts;
“Not now” is remembered until it changes
again.
The source was moved
Source not found · Find replacement…
Looked up by its uid on every server on your
map, so a moved or restored file heals
itself. Otherwise you pick one.
The source is sealed
Source is sealed · Open to compare…
Uses your own session on the source, or the
Open dialog. No password or key is ever
stored in this document.
Detach link makes it an own table: the cells become editable and the source is forgotten (one step, undoable). A linked table lists in the sources list with its source’s name and revision.
G · The rules it follows
Keyboard
Insert ▸ Table… (key to be chosen: every Ctrl+Alt
letter is taken). Tab and Shift+Tab move between
cells; Tab in the last cell adds a row. Enter
starts a new line in the cell (a cell is one
paragraph, D181).
Screen readers / BITV
A real table: caption, header cells with scope,
name and description read out; the total row is
the footer; reading order is row by row.
Collaboration
The cell someone is in is locked around the
caret; a change of rows or columns is refused
while another person is in the rows it touches.
Every cell’s words keep their authors.
Files
odt: a table with its name, header rows, rows
that do not split. docx: a table with a repeating
header row. Merged cells, nested tables and cell
colours are kept in the file and listed as not
understood.
